review_notes: This is a text-focused export of the current active catalogue, not evidence that every historical description has been independently approved.

All 67 records retain source URLs. Ten records contain no English description after underscore placeholders are normalized; retrieval must return insufficient evidence for those records until descriptions are sourced.
Source URLs have HTTP(S) syntax; this does not establish source correctness or availability.
The scan-source links for some exhibits identify geometry or replicas. Those links alone do not verify every historical statement in a description.
NEFERTITI_REPLICA describes a modern replica. It must not be relabelled as the ancient original.
The date and dynasty fields retain blank values. Some fields, including the replica date, contain descriptive text rather than normalized dates.
Original category/civilization wording is retained. No new historical facts or translations were added.
English text only. Arabic descriptions are outside this submission at the user's request.
Image-collection review decisions and recognition validation/test results belong to the CV dataset handoff and are not included here.
